title: Sports Trivia
content:
Sports Trivia
Can we guess which college team you root for? Are you ready for a seriously hard NBA quiz? Welcome to the wide world of HowStuffWorks Play sports trivia.
Learn More
Hoops, baby, hoops! Take a break from thinking about your bracket, and check this quiz! Can we guess your favorite NCAA men's basketball team? You miss 100% of the shots you don't take, so we're giving it our best.
By Alex Wittman
Alright baseball fans, it's time to put on your thinking cap and find out if you know all 30 Major League Baseball teams. Sure, you might know the "Evil Empire" in New York, but what about the two teams playing games in Florida? Take a swing at this quiz to find out!
By Gavin Thagard
If a treble hook is no trouble and you can keep it real with a rod and reel, if you won't get sunk by a bobber or snagged on a net, then maybe you can ID some of what we have in our tackle box. Take the quiz and see!
By Ian Fortey
Advertisement
Rah, rah, ree - kick 'em in the knee! Which college team gets you off your seat and screaming at the TV? Take this quiz, and we'll figure out which one you call your favorite.
By Teresa McGlothlin
In an era where superteams are common, everyone tries to imagine which players would fit best together. But what does that dream team tell you about who you are as a coach? Here's your chance to find out!
By Gavin Thagard
From the moment he hit the court, Kobe Bryant was destined to be a superstar in the NBA. Take this quiz and find out how much you know about the legacy he shaped over his 20-year career!
By Gavin Thagard
As one of many professional sports leagues, it can get quite confusing when you start listing off the names of the teams in the NFL. Here's a quiz that will only add to that confusion. Will you be able to pass it?
By Gavin Thagard
Advertisement
One of the great things about baseball is every ballpark has its own quirks and unique dimensions. Are you a big enough baseball fan to identify all 30 parks from a photo? Start this quiz to find out!
By Daniel Yetman
We all know soccer isn't just for the boys. Women have the speed, the intensity, the ferocity and the talent to play this game like no one else. But which legend of the game are you? If it's your goooooooaaaaaal to find out, take the quiz!
By Ian Fortey
There are currently 30 NBA teams and about 500 players in the league, but there have been more than 3,000 players in the history of the NBA and dozens of teams. That's a lot of stats, a lot of stories and a lot of wins, losses and legends. Let's see what you know.
By Jonnathan Chadwick
Whether they were winning Super Bowls or racking up insane sack totals, these NFL stars captivated fans throughout the 2010s. Will you recognize them for their heroics on the field? Tackle this quiz to find out!
By Gavin Thagard
Advertisement
Whether they were winning Super Bowls or racking up insane sack totals, these NFL stars captivated fans throughout the 2010s. Will you recognize them for their heroics on the field? Tackle this quiz to find out!
By Gavin Thagard
The WWE showcased the greatest legends in the history of professional wrestling, brother! Do you think you know your heroes from your zeroes? Ring the bell and find out how well you remember your WWE legends!
By Zoe Samuel
Everyone has that NFL dream team they'd love to assemble, but what can a roster of your favorite players tell us about what kind of coach you would be? Tackle this quiz and find out!
By Gavin Thagard
The NBA might be a player's league, but that doesn't diminish the importance of an NBA team, especially in the cities where they're located. Will you be able to match these teams to their logo if the colors are all changed around? Jump into this quiz to find out!
By Gavin Thagard
Advertisement
What do you get when you add the NFL, NBA, MLB and NHL? Why, this quiz of course! How's your recall? Can you identify which league the logos in this quiz belong to? Lock down these logos and lock up a quiz win!
By Beth Hendricks
The Republic of Ireland national football team has come a long way, both in the history of the sport and of Ireland itself, but how well do you know the recent players? Could you recognize them on sight?
By Zoe Samuel
Many different skills go into making the perfect player ... and which ones you have tells us which rugby star you most resemble. It's time to find out!
By Zoe Samuel
Can you Sa-MELLLL the questions cookin'? We got the beefcakes and oiled muscles ... and the baby faces, of course. Do you have what it takes to be the best there is, the best there was and the best there ever will be?
By Lauren Lubas
Advertisement
There's no perfect formula to being a successful NFL general manager, as they each implement different strategies to build a championship team. Some of them like to play the odds, while others make pretty risky moves. Take this quiz and find out where you fall on that scale!
By Gavin Thagard
Cricket is an ancient game that became one of the most popular forms of sport in the world. Those who play cricket are part of a long tradition of joy and heartbreak, but how many of those players can you recognize?
By Zoe Samuel
Reaching the Challenge Cup means taking high-risk, high-reward decisions, and it all starts with building your team. Will you gamble it all to win the greatest prize?
By Zoe Samuel
LeBron James may be the best player you've ever seen, or maybe you have to rank him right behind Michael Jordan ... or Wilt Chamberlain ... or Julius Erving. Build us your All-Star team, and we'll tell you just how old you are!
By Ian Fortey
Advertisement
He shoots ... he sroces! (Wait, that's not right ...) Can you decipher these mixed-up NBA team names? Unscramble the letters to identify the basketball franchise. Be a "Trailblazer" and work your "Magic!"
By Beth Hendricks
The National Baseball Hall of Fame is the storied structure designed to recount the sport's history and honor the greatest players to step onto the field. How well do you know your baseball legends? Can you match their faces to their names?
By Zoe Samuel
